# System Exec.vi

![System Exec.vi function icon](../../../assets/function-icons/functions/connectivity/LIB-02.svg)

[Connectivity functions](index.md) · [All functions](../index.md)

Runs a system command or executable and returns its standard streams and exit code.

## Studio authoring profile

Contract status: **partial**. The connector below describes Studio authoring; execution availability is stated separately.

## IN — inputs

| Displayed terminal / internal ID | Accepted / resolved type | Studio connection | Unwired input default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| wait until completion? `wait_until_completion` | `bool` | Recommended | `true` | Waits for the process so its input and output streams are available. |
| command line `command_line` | `string` | Required | Not specified | Executable or system command, including any command-line arguments. |
| standard input `standard_input` | `string` | Recommended | Not specified | Text delivered to the command when waiting for completion. |
| working directory `working_directory` | `path` | Recommended | Not specified | Directory used by the launched executable after it starts. |
| error in `error_in` | `cluster<status:bool,code:i32,source:string>` | Recommended | `{status:false,code:0,source:""}` | Carries error information from earlier diagram operations. |
| run minimized? `run_minimized` | `bool` | Recommended | `false` | Requests a minimized executable window on supported operating systems. |
